question: When does the admission process start and what is the last date to apply?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Admissions for the academic year 2026-27 at Demo University open on May 1st and close on June 30th. Late applications are accepted with a late fee until July 15th.

question: How can I apply for undergraduate admissions online?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Prospective students must register on the Demo University Admissions Portal (admissions.demouniv.edu), complete the online form, upload required certificates, and pay an application fee of $50.

question: Is there an entrance exam for admission to Demo University?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Yes, Demo University conducts the Demo University Common Entrance Test (DUCET) for all B.Tech and MBA programs. Direct admission is available for candidates with top 5% percentiles in national examinations.

question: What undergraduate engineering courses are offered?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Demo University offers four-year B.Tech programs in Computer Science & Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, Electronics & Communication Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering.

question: Are postgraduate and doctoral degree programs available?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Yes, Demo University provides M.Tech, MBA, M.Sc in Data Science, and Ph.D. research fellowships across Engineering, Sciences, and Management disciplines.

question: Can undergraduate students choose interdisciplinary minors?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Yes, undergraduate students can take minors in disciplines such as Computational Finance, Cybersecurity, Environmental Studies, and Product Design starting from their 3rd semester.

question: What are the eligibility criteria for B.Tech Computer Science?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Applicants must have completed 10+2 or equivalent with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Computer Science, securing a minimum aggregate of 60% (55% for reserved categories).

question: What are the eligibility requirements for the MBA program?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Candidates must hold a recognized Bachelor's degree in any discipline with at least 50% aggregate marks and a valid score in DUCET-Management or national CAT/GMAT exams.
source: School of Management Admissions Manual, Sec 1.2

question: Are international students eligible to apply?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] International applicants are eligible provided they have equivalent qualification credentials evaluated by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) and valid English proficiency scores (TOEFL/IELTS).
source: International Affairs Directorate, Doc ID IAD-2026

question: What is the annual tuition fee for B.Tech programs?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] The annual tuition fee for B.Tech programs is $4,000 (INR 3,20,000) payable in two equal semester installments. A one-time refundable security deposit of $300 is charged at admission.

question: What is the fee structure for MBA programs?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] The total program fee for the two-year MBA is $9,500 (INR 7,60,000), which includes tuition, course material, access to business simulation labs, and industry immersions.

question: What is the refund policy if a student withdraws admission?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] 100% of fees minus $20 processing charge is refunded if withdrawn 15 days before classes commence; 80% if within 15 days before; 50% within 15 days after classes start; zero refund after 30 days.
source: Demo University Refund Guidelines, UGC Aligned 2026

question: Does Demo University offer merit-based scholarships?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Yes, the Chancellor's Merit Scholarship awards up to 100% tuition waiver to students ranking in the top 1% of DUCET, and 50% tuition waiver for students scoring above 90% in 10+2 examinations.

question: Are there need-based or sports scholarships available?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Yes, Demo University offers the Need-cum-Means Grant covering up to 40% tuition for families with annual income under $8,000, and Sports Excellence Fellowships for national medalists.

question: What hostel facilities and room types are available on campus?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Demo University provides separate air-conditioned and non-AC hostels for boys and girls with single, double, and triple-occupancy rooms. All hostels include 24/7 Wi-Fi, laundry, and dining halls.

question: What is the annual hostel and mess fee?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] The annual hostel fee ranges from $1,200 (triple non-AC) to $2,200 (single AC) per year. The mess charge is $900 annually, covering breakfast, lunch, evening snacks, and dinner.

question: What are the hostel curfew timings and leave rules?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Campus curfew is 9:30 PM for all resident students. Overnight leave requires prior digital approval from parents and the hostel warden via the Campus Life App.

question: What are the central library working hours and digital resources?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] The Central Library is open from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM on weekdays, and 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on weekends. During semester exams, reading halls operate 24/7 with access to IEEE, ACM, and Springer journals.

question: How many books can a student borrow and for what duration?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Undergraduate students can borrow up to 4 books for 14 days, while postgraduate and research scholars can borrow up to 8 books for 30 days. Renewals are done via the web OPAC.

question: What is the mandatory attendance requirement to appear for examinations?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] A minimum of 75% attendance in each registered course is mandatory to be eligible for end-semester examinations. Medical condonation up to 10% is permitted with Dean approval.

question: What is the grading system and CGPA calculation method?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Demo University follows a 10-point relative grading scale: O (10), A+ (9), A (8), B+ (7), B (6), C (5), and F (Fail, 0). CGPA is computed as the credit-weighted average of grade points.

question: What are the rules and process for supplementary or re-evaluation exams?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Students receiving an 'F' grade can appear for supplementary examinations held in July and January. Re-evaluation requests must be submitted within 10 days of results declaration for a fee of $15 per paper.

question: Does the university provide bus transportation services for day scholars?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Yes, Demo University operates a fleet of 25 GPS-tracked air-conditioned buses covering all major metropolitan routes within a 45-kilometer radius of the campus.

question: What is the transport fee and how are bus passes issued?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Transport fees range between $350 and $600 per academic year depending on distance zones. Digital bus passes with RFID smart cards are issued through the student portal.
source: Transport Department Services Notice 2026, Schedule B

question: What original documents are required during physical verification at admission?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Required documents: 10th and 12th original marksheets and passing certificates, transfer certificate (TC), migration certificate, category certificate (if applicable), 6 passport-size photographs, and government ID proof.

question: How can alumni or graduating students request an official transcript or degree certificate?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Official transcripts and provisional certificates can be requested through the Student Services Portal (records.demouniv.edu). Standard dispatch takes 7-10 working days, with international courier options.

question: What is the procedure for obtaining a bona fide or character certificate?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Students can download an automated digitally signed bona fide certificate directly from their student dashboard within 24 hours of application, without physical signatures.

question: What are the contact details and working hours of the Admissions Helpdesk?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Admissions Helpdesk: Phone: +1 (555) 019-2830, Email: admissions@demouniv.edu. Location: Welcome Centre, Ground Floor, Admin Block. Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM.

question: Who can I contact in case of an on-campus medical emergency?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Campus Health Centre Emergency Line: +1 (555) 019-9999 (24/7). Ambulances and doctors are stationed around the clock near the Student Activity Centre.

question: What is the official address and location of Demo University?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Demo University Main Campus, 100 Innovation Boulevard, Tech Valley, CA 94016. The campus is located 12 kilometers from Central Metro Station.

question: Can I get a campus tour before deciding on admission?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] Yes, Demo University conducts guided campus tours every Saturday at 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM. Prospective students can reserve their slots through the Admissions Portal.

question: Does Demo University offer internship and placement assistance?
answer: [DEMONSTRATION DATA] The Centre for Corporate Relations facilitates mandatory summer internships and campus placements. In 2025-26, over 200 companies visited with an average package of $14,000 (INR 11.2 LPA).
